Container.Name: PanaControl
Container.Overview:
Remote control for LUMIX cameras over the cam.cgi protocol: live view in the browser, autofocus, start and stop video recording, ISO, and the current aperture as a reading. Developed against a DC-GH6 with firmware 3.01.
Give the container its own address on the LAN (network br0, fixed IP). The camera sends the live view by UDP to exactly the address the request came from, so camera and container must be in the same subnet: with a router or a separate VLAN in between, the control works but no picture arrives. Don't use bridge with port mapping: a frame of about 23 KB travels as one UDP datagram in 17 IP fragments, and Docker's NAT drops whole frames when one fragment is lost. Host networking works too.
The web interface is on port 8080 of the container's address. It has no login: whoever reaches it controls the camera. For access from outside, put a reverse proxy with authentication in front.
Stopping: --stop-timeout 30 gives the app time to release the camera's remote session. A hard kill locks the camera out until it is switched off and on again.
Based on linuxserver.io's Alpine image. The app writes no files and runs as PUID:PGID, never as root. Upgrading from 1.x: remove --read-only, --cap-drop ALL and the --cap-add options from Extra Parameters, or the container won't start.

Config.Name: LUMIX_CAMERA_IP
Config.Description: The camera's address on the local network, for example 192.0.2.10

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody). Not 0.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users). Not 0.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the time stamps in the log, for example Europe/Berlin

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask. The app writes no files; kept for consistency with other linuxserver.io images.

Config.Name: LUMIX_DEVICE_NAME
Config.Description: Name shown on the camera's display during registration

Config.Name: LUMIX_STREAM_PORT
Config.Description: UDP port for the live view, on the container's own address

Config.Name: LUMIX_WEB_HOST
Config.Description: Where the interface listens inside the container. 0.0.0.0 opens it to the network; it has no login.

Config.Name: LUMIX_WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port of the interface on the container's own address
